zero_state.argument: f(s)=16807*l-2836*h with s=127773h+l; |16807*l|<2.2e9 and 2836*h<4.2e17 << 2^64 so f(s)==0 mod 2^64 iff 16807*l==2836*h; gcd(16807,2836)=1 => l=2836m,h=16807m, l<127773 => m<=45, s=m*2147483647. Same for ILP32 (m<=2). Lehmer states below 2^31-1 never equal m*(2^31-1), m>=1; a state can reach 0 only by hitting one of 45 specific 64-bit (2 specific 32-bit) values after a negative-residue wrap.

bash5.1.source: bash-5.1 lib/sh/random.c (sha256 of the extracted file 2fddd31f886b7ca9; tarball cc012bc860406dcf): intrand32() Lehmer/Schrage, brand() fold, genseed(), seedrand(); variables.c l.608 seedrand(); l.1363 get_random_number()
bash5.1.diff_from_4.2: DIFFERENT generator: 32-bit u_bits32_t state, signed h,l,t Schrage with the `t<0 -> t+0x7fffffff` correction ENABLED (a true Lehmer minimal-standard single cycle of length 2^31-2; 4.x has it #if 0'd on a 64-bit unsigned), zero -> 123459876, output folded (rseed>>16)^(rseed&65535) & 32767 when shell_compatibility_level > 50 (default). Auto-seed is genseed() = tv_sec ^ tv_usec ^ getpid() ^ getppid() ^ uid ^ (u32)(address of seedrand()).
bash5.1.auto_seed_formula: iv = tv_sec ^ tv_usec ^ getpid() ^ getppid() ^ current_user.uid ^ (u32)&seedrand. Under ASLR/PIE the address term randomises bits 12..31, making the effective seed space the whole 2^31 cycle (27.7x the 4.2 orbit; not enumerated). Enumerated here: NON-PIE builds, where the term is a constant c and only x=(c>>20) (text at 0x400000-0x5fffff => x in {4,5}) shifts the prefix: seed prefix = (tv_sec>>20) XOR x, low 20 bits free (usec, pid, ppid, uid, c-low all < 2^20). Union over x in 0..7 = 88 x 2^20 = 92,274,688 seeds (352 chunks); one build = exactly 74 x 2^20; chunk order x=4 image first. Compat level <= 50 (BASH_COMPAT=50) would give the unfolded output and is NOT covered.
